chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Zurārah, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام strongly urged us regarding salat al-jumuʿah until I thought that he wanted us to come to him. So I said, “Shall we go early to you?” He said, “No, I only meant among yourselves.”

key_terms.حَثَّنَا: he strongly urged and encouraged us
key_terms.عِنْدَكُمْ: in your own place or among yourselves
key_terms.نَغْدُو: we go early in the morning

ai.seo_question: Can people living in a village establish salat al-jumuʿah among themselves without going to the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام emphasized the importance of salat al-jumuʿah for a group in their own locality. When the narrator assumed this meant traveling to the Imam, the Imam clarified that he intended for them to establish it where they were. Its significance is in indicating the permissibility of holding Jumuʿah locally in their village setting.
